cards.text: We made it to the last page of the whole Bible, friend. John, the man who saw this whole vision (Revelation 1:1, 9), has just been shown the holy city coming down out of heaven from God (Revelation 21:10). Now the angel who showed him around says, "These words are faithful and true."

cards.question: The angel says the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to His servants. What did He send the angel to show them?

answers.text: How the city was first built

cards.text: Then come these words: "Behold, I am coming soon." And before you ask me WHEN, friend, I'm a cookie stamper with a mustache, and Matthew 24:36 says only the Father knows.

cards.question: Right after "Behold, I am coming soon" comes a blessing. Who is blessed?

answers.text: Whoever keeps the words of this book
Whoever sees an angel up close

cards.text: Now John speaks up: "And I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things." And when he's heard and seen it all, down he goes, right at the angel's feet.

cards.question: John falls down at the angel's feet to ___ him.

cards.text: The angel stops him cold: "Do not do that!" Friend, John did this same thing back in Revelation 19:10 and heard those same words, and after everything he's seen? I'd hit the floor twice too.

cards.question: The angel tells John he's a fellow ___ with him, with the prophets and with those who keep the words of this book.
The angel won't take John's worship. Who does the angel tell John to worship instead?

cards.text: Then the angel tells John not to seal up the words of prophecy in this book. Friend, I seal cookie boxes ALL day long, and here's the one thing that's supposed to stay OPEN.

cards.question: The angel says to leave the book unsealed because the time is still far off. True or false?

cards.text: Then the angel says something heavy: "Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile" and he's not finished.

cards.question: The angel goes on: the righteous should keep practicing righteousness, and the holy should keep being holy. True or false?

cards.text: And then that line again: "Behold, I am coming soon." This time, a reward comes along with Him.

cards.question: The One who is coming brings His reward with Him. How does He give it to each one?

answers.text: By what each one has done
By how long each one waited
By the city each one is from

cards.text: Then He says who He is, and He doesn't stop at one title. Friend, He stacks three of them, back to back to BACK.

cards.question: He says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End." What do all three titles say about Him?

answers.text: He is there from start to finish
He was the first of the prophets
He is the last of the angels

cards.text: Now a blessing: "Blessed are those who wash their robes," and friend, this blessing comes with something BIG.

cards.question: Those who wash their robes get the right to something. What is it?
Those who wash their robes may also enter the city by its gates. True or false?

cards.text: Then comes a hard list: the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

cards.question: The dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood are inside the city. True or false?

cards.text: Then Jesus Himself speaks: "I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony" and He says exactly who it's for.

cards.question: Jesus sent His angel to give this testimony for the ___.
Jesus calls Himself the Root and the Offspring of a famous king. Which king?

cards.text: And one more title: "the bright Morning Star." My boy Berry watched the night sky from that kitchen window every single night, and friend, he'd be up on his TIPTOES for this one.
Then comes an invitation, and I know a little about those, because somebody once came all the way to the back of a junk drawer with one for ME. The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!"

cards.question: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Who else gets to say it too?
The one who is thirsty is invited to come. And the one who desires something is invited to drink it freely. What is it?

cards.text: Then a serious warning goes out to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book. Friend, in my bakery you can toss extra sprinkles on anything, but this book is NOT that kind of recipe.

cards.question: If anyone adds to these words, God will add to him the ___ described in this book.
If anyone takes away from the words of this book, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city. True or false?

cards.text: Then He who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." That's the third time in this passage, friend, and you won't hear me complain, because my ovens stay HOT.

cards.question: Right after "Yes, I am coming soon" comes an answer. What does it ask the Lord Jesus?
The very last verse of the Bible asks for the grace of the Lord Jesus to be with John alone. True or false?

cards.text: That's how the whole Bible ends, friend: grace for all the saints, and then "Amen." And coming from a stamper somebody found in the back of a junk drawer, I can tell you there's no better ending.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: "The angel stops him cold: 'Do not do that!'", "Friend, John did this same thing back in Revelation 19:10 and heard those same words, and after everything he's seen?" and "I'd hit the floor twice too." It also carries three beats: the angel stopping John, the callback to Revelation 19:10, and the joke. Split it, or trim it to one or two beats in one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card has more than two things happening: the angel's rebuke, the earlier time in Revelation 19:10, and Papa Dorin's reaction.

rule.text: Aim for one beat per story card. Two is the most. If a story card has more than two things happening, split it.
